SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_MINI_MICRO: At the start of combat, channel an Attack, Skill, and Power note in that order.
Ready to show the Spire your voice?
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_FUMO.title: Fumo
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_FUMO.descr: At the start of combat, gain 1 Forte.
At the end of your turn, gain 2 Block. If your HP is at or below 50%, gain 4 Block instead.
Lightweight, but still useful at a critical moment.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_ENCORE_STA: The first Performance card you manually play each turn Performs 1 additional time.
Even after the song ends, the lights refuse to fade.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_WEATHERED_: At the start of combat, generate 1 Attack Note. For every 7 damage taken during the journey since obtaining this relic, generate 1 additional Attack Note.
Every scratch remembers a road that never stopped.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_DECENNIAL_: Every 7th Chord each combat triggers twice.
The seventh beat always lands louder.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_GOLDEN_REC: Whenever a Chord triggers, gain 2 Gold.
SLAY_THE_SPIRE2_MGR_MOD_RELIC_CONFUSED_L: At the start of combat, add 1 Doubtful+ to your hand.
Opening it makes you forget what you meant to see.
